name: EPIC 235288951
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 18.8 solar radii and 1.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 235288951 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM radius (solar radii) 18.777835 (16th-84th percentiles 17.927482-19.413718), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,683 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.96 solar masses and 18.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,670 K at its surface.
